title: Act: Call playSceneTransition from BootScene.create
summary: Wire the helper into BootScene.create after effects are built.
description: Import playSceneTransition and call it in BootScene.create with the shared effect context.

steps.action: Add import { playSceneTransition } from '@game/engine/playSceneTransition'; in create() replace the inline createPhaserEffectContext(this) argument with a const ctx, pass ctx to buildEffects, then call playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) right after.
steps.expected: create() builds effects then plays the authored fade.
